Set up Ubilink

Ubilink needs two macOS permissions to capture links from your apps.

    Accessibility

    Lets Ubilink script an app's menus — needed for apps like Bear that have no API.

    Automation

    Lets Ubilink read the link of the app you're in (browsers, Finder, …).
